text: Skymaster is a Sangheili military title. The title indicates its recipients are the most skilled and gifted pilots available to the Covenant. Skymasters are sometimes expected to train newer generations of pilots; Skymaster 'Dalamen was famed for training all the Seraph strike pilots aboard Ardent Prayer.

Stefan Vídalín was a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier of the United Nations Space Command. He served in the UNSC as part of the complement of during the Created uprising of 2559, though was ultimately killed during the Battle of Boundary on December 15 of that year. His death came at the hands of another Spartan, Merrick, who was a double agent working for the Order of Restoration.
Tomas Horvath is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier of Fireteam Intrepid in the United Nations Space Command.
The Mark V Special Operations Craft is an American small transport boat in service with the United States Navy Special Warfare Command since 1995, designed and manufactured by Halter Marine Inc.
Unstable Jump Brutes are a specialised type of Jiralhanae Jumper employed by the Banished, particularly Yapyap and his rebellion.

Spartan Commander Vinay Sahil is a SPARTAN-IV supersoldier of the United Nations Space Command. As of March 3, 2560, Sahil serves as the commander for the Spartan Operations detachment on Anvil Station, directing the station's operations alongside Stationmaster Toda ’Murajai.
Major Curtis "Zeal" Bowman is a mercenary pilot. He flies a Su-47 Berkut.

The Mikoyan MiG-29 (NATO reporting name: Fulcrum) is a fourth-generation air superiority jet fighter aircraft designed in the Soviet Union in the 1970s. The MiG-29, along with the Sukhoi Su-27, was developed to counter new American fighters such as the F-15 Eagle, and the F-16 Fighting Falcon. It was exported to multiple nations outside the Soviet Union and saw many combats since, although reports are mixed depending on who used it. The MiG-29 appears in Battlefield 2 and Battlefield Play4Free. __TOC__
2-Bopsteady The Two-Headed Tower of Terror!, is an evil character in the Turtles of Grayskull action figure line and mini-comics. He is a mixture of Bebop and Rocksteady, in a Two Bad way.

Reaching out through the Orb of Power, hidden deep inside Castle Grayskull, The Sorceress of Castle Grayskull used an unrepeatable spell to call upon the Power of Grayskull and infuse life into the very spirit of the castle itself. Rising from the castle's hidden Chamber of Defense, Castle Grayskullman marched into battle, swinging his dual swords of power, helping to turn the tide.

Originally a partner with Kronis, Scychor roamed the galaxy as a mercenary and professional thief. Eventually Kronis betrayed his friend, throwing Scychor from a Boa Jet while escaping from Horde Patrol Units. Falling hundreds of feet to the surface of a small moon, Scychor was healed by rogue scientists by preserving his organs in a robotic chest and his brain in a cyborg skull. After serving the scientists for twenty years, he became a freelance bounty hunter, willing to steal, kill or betray anyone for the right price. During the Second Ultimate Battleground, Cy-Chop was hired by Hordak to bolster his forces against the Snake Men and Masters of the Universe. Using his robotic scissor blades, Cy-Chop strikes out, but only for the right price!

The MiG-21 (Russian: Микоян и Гуревич МиГ-21; NATO reporting name "Fishbed") is a Soviet supersonic jet aircraft designed by Mikoyan-Gurevich in the late 1950s, and was the result of further development of the MiG-19. It was largely exported to the communist bloc, as well as other Soviet-supplied nations. It is a relatively small and agile aircraft, and was a thorough match to American aircraft of the time, giving the MiG-21 a sound reputation as an effective fighter, and is still in active service with some air forces today.

The Darmi were a small group of humans adorned in togas consisting of Verdor, Cara and Bylon. They lived on the war-torn planet of Mero where they were the only survivors of a once grand and powerful civilisation. In order to amuse themselves in the aftermath of their Great War, they watchend and gambled on dragon fights in their arena. When they began to run out of gladiators to pit against each other, they were visited by the evil warrior Kobra Khan, who came up with a plan to transport the dragons of Darksmoke on the planet Eternia to Mero to be used in the arena fights. The Darmi eventually saw the error of their ways and swore to use their considerable powers to rebuild Mero.

Eldor is the name of a planned character for the cancelled The Powers of Grayskull toyline. In the planned storyline, Eldor was (the 1st) He-Ro's mentor and the guardian of the Book of Living Spells (which was supposed to come as an accessory for the figure).

Etherian Eagles are the Etherian equivilant of an Earth eagle.. Etherian Eagles are form of Etherian Bird. Adora got two Etherian Eagles to help the Rebellion's cause to protect the Whispering Woods from being destroyed by the poison of Kandahar. The Eagles worked as a pair to carry a large net into battle, by each holding one end of it's rope in their beak. The net was used to force a Horde Trooper flying a Horde Jet Machine down to the ground.

The MiG-17 (NATO reporting name: Fresco) was a Soviet high-subsonic fighter aircraft designed by Mikoyan-Gurevich in early 1950s and produced in the USSR from 1952 and operated by numerous air forces of communist bloc nations in many variants. It was the result of further development of the Korean War-era MiG-15, and was further improved into the MiG-19. It saw most of its combat service during the Vietnam War, where it was used by the North Vietnamese Air Force. __TOC__

He-Slave is a character who appeared in the The New Adventures of He-Man. He-Slave was a clone of He-Man, called "He-Slave" by Skeletor. He was created by using a stolen Geneticator that was invented by the scientist Graznor to cure illnesses. During a battle with the actual He-Man, He-Slave knew exactly what move He-Man was going to make, thus making it almost impossible to beat He-Slave. However, when Skeletor grew impatient and decided to finish both of them. Angered by this, He-Slave turned against his creator and attempted to destroy him by dropping a large Solar Generator on him. He-Slave did not survive the resulting explosion, but Skeletor did.

The Great Beast is a dinosaur like animal that lives on Beast Island on the planet Etheria. Members of the Jungle Tribe led by J'Milla trained themselves from a young age to become "Beast Warriors," for the Great Beast regularly came to their village. However, when Adora faced a Great Beast, she found out that the animal only came in response to the Kodge Trumpet being blown. The sound of the trumpet is like that of a wounded beast, and the creature came, thinking it could help one of its own.

:For the rock-like characters from the toy line, see Rock People. The Rock Men, also known as rock creatures and rock people, are a race of vaguely humanoid creatures apparently made of solid rock. They dwell in caverns deep beneath Eternia, which are rarely accessible to surface-dwellers. Primitive and unintelligent, the Rock Men enjoy a simplistic, peaceful culture, fueled by the natural heat, light, and energy they receive from a giant bottomless pit that taps into the center of the planet. They know little of the ways of violence or fighting, as few Rock Men have ever ventured above ground to see the evil that transpires there. The Rock Men's way of life was threatened when Rabar and Togar briefly emerged in the surface world and discovered He-Man's Power Sword. Rabar believed this weapon made him a great warrior and leader, and he took the blade back underground with him to lord it over his people. He-Man and his friends managed to follow Rabar and Togar, and convinced them both that powerful weapons doesn't make anyone a leader.

The NJ 2046 is a high mobility truck jointly produced by Nanjing Motor Corporation of China and IVECO of Italy introduced in 2001. The vehicle itself is Chinese-produced and designated variant of the IVECO 40.10WM military truck, and the two are nearly identical. The NJ 2046 is armed with a ring-mounted Type 85 HMG that can be replaced by an HJ-8 ATGM launcher if necessary in an anti-armor role.

A Rabbot is any one of a series of floating, egg-shaped robots used by Plundor as enforcers on the planet Trannis. Gleedil once referred to them as "Plundor's Droids". These large, dangerous machines came equipped with various attachments to their arms, including saw blades and sleep smoke emitters. As they were mechanical beings rather than alive, He-Man and Battle Cat did not restrain themselves when facing the Rabbots, and destroyed them as quickly and efficiently as possible.

The Qadians (or Cat-Folk) are a race of humanoid felines native to the planet Eternia. They are lead by Chief Carnivus who keeps his people safe high in the village of Felis Qadi. For many years the Qadians kept a neutral stance, preferring not to get involved in the affairs of other tribes. But with the rise of Skeletor and the subsequent release of the Snake Men and the Horde from their interdimensional prisons, Carnivus agreed to re-evaluate his core principles and joined the struggle for freedom allying himself and his people with King Randor’s new Eternian Council. Carnivus uses his feline agility and great courage to fight against evil.
Splinter-Skull is a ethereal being character in the Turtles of Grayskull action figure line and mini-comics.

Maintenance is the act of keeping a vehicle or other machine in top condition. Well-maintained vehicles last longer than average, and may tolerate conditions that a non-maintained vehicle might not withstand.
The Shredder Evil Master of Ninjitsu!, is an evil character in the Turtles of Grayskull action figure line and mini-comics.

Torgs are a race of creatures native to Eternia. Small in stature, yet very muscular, they live in underground caves. In ancient times, the Torgs were an almost unstoppable force thanks to their so called "prince of destruction", the demonic creature known as Molkrom. The Elders used their magic to imprison Molkron in crystal, deep in the caves in which the Torgs live. Centuries later, the Torgs were all but forgotten by the surface dwelling populace of Eternia. Now led by King Von, they contacted Skeletor and asked him to free Molkrom. When Skeletor's magic failed, he concluded he needed something that posessed the power of the Elders. Von was aware that one such item was the Staff of Avion and that it just happened to be used during a yearly celebration in Avion at that time. Von and his Torgs attacked Avion in their flying Torg Ships and Von himself managed to grab both the staff and it's wielder, Stratos with a large claw portruding from his ship. Skeletor put a spell on Stratos and forced him to tell him how to use the staff to find the weakness in the crystal that held Molkrom. After releasing the demon, Skeletor left the staff in the care of Von and went to attack Castle Grayskull with Molkrom. King Von stashed the staff in an underground vault, but Teela managed to sneak in. Despite having both the staff and a large club at his command, Von was defeated and tied up by Teela. Eventually, the Staff, having depleted it's evil energy without taking half of Eternia with it

, birth name , is the main female protagonist of the spin-off series, Yūryō Bukken Mō Dame Sō: Furo, Toilet to Tenshi wa Kyōdō Desu. She is an angel who was sent to help Yuugo Sayama. It's later revealed that Hamuel isn't an angel but a ghost sent from the heaven, as a result of Yuugo refused to forget her and let go of his regrets on how he "killed" her.

The de Havilland DH.98 Mosquito was a British multi-purpose military aircraft that was used during World War II. It was manufactured by the de Havilland Aircraft Company and entered service in 1941. The Mosquito was mainly used as a fighter-bomber, but was also utilized as a reconnaissance and anti-ship aircraft. Over 7,000 were built.

Named after the strain of Terminids that existed during the First Galactic War, the Brood Commander is a heavily-armored and dangerous that is a mutated rare strain of the Warrior and member of the Terminid Leadership Caste. They can be distinguished from Warriors by their larger size, bigger head, coloration and their mandibles. Brood Commanders appear in two types: *Brood Commanders - Have a dark brown-orange carapace and can summon Warriors. *Alpha Commanders - Appear with a different head crest and a fiery orange carapace. Has higher health and armor, and can summon Alpha Warriors.

Not to be confused with Steven Caves, Steve Storms is a government-approved weather expert, brought in by the Federation to update citizens about chaotic weather conditions, specifically intense wind and lightning storms caused by Exospires. Citizens are assured that while stronger winds have been reported lately, it is nothing to worry about: just a light breeze of Liberty. While Exospires are producing lightning storms beyond all comprehension, 's brave are making sure everything goes back to normal. Furthermore, reports that Steve Storms was killed by a lightning strike are said to be unfounded and false. On an unrelated note, citizens are advised not to carry umbrellas during exostorms.
Phantom, also known as Ventriloquist, is a minor character and an antagonist in Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number. He is a strange entity that confronts Manny Pardo in a nightmare he has.

The Munitionspanzer IV was a German support vehicle used during World War II. Built from a modified Panzer IV chassis, Munitionspanzers had their turrets removed and were refitted to carry ammunition and supplies for troops. They had no primary guns and instead relied on gunner positions on the hull equipped with MG34s for defense. A specialized variant of the Munitionspanzer equipped with a crane, called the Munitionsschlepper, were used to transport and load the two ton shells used by the Karl-Gerät siege mortar during the eastern campaigns.

is a minor antagonist featured in Steel Ball Run. A geologist by trade and also working as one of President Funny Valentine's henchmen, Dr. Ferdinand ambushes Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli alongside a transformed Diego Brando in the Rocky Mountains to take the Saint's Corpse's eyes from them. He is a Stand User and controls hordes of dinosaurs through his Scary Monsters.
is a Stand featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. It is the Stand of Muryotaisu Nijimura from the 37th Universe. Grand Bleu manifests of three sentient dolphins, each with their own name.

, also known as , is the protagonist of Baoh: The Visitor. A teenager, Ikuro is kidnapped and transformed into the bioweapon "Baoh" by the Doress Laboratory. Ikuro is notable for being the only non-JoJo character featured in the 2013 fighting game JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All Star Battle and its remake.

The NSV (Russian НСВ Никитина-Соколова-Волкова) is a Soviet-made 12.7mm heavy machine gun named after the designers, G. I. Nikitin (Г. И. Никитин), Y. S. Sokolov (Ю. М. Соколов) and V. I. Volkov (В. И. Волков). It was designed in 1971 to replace the DShK. The weapon was stopped from being produced in Russia in 1998 following the break up of the USSR, with the KORD developed to replace the NSV the same year. The NSV weighs 25 kg, has a rate of fire of 13 rounds per second, and an effective range of 1,500 meters. A fully loaded ammunition belt with 50 rounds weighs 11 kg.
is a minor antagonist featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He is the mastermind behind the fifteen locked room murders which he had used his Wound to haunt people's dreams.

An unnamed assassin, the is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders. He is one of the many mercenaries sent by DIO to assassinate the Joestar Group on their way to Egypt. He secretly boards a vessel the protagonists were using for their journey and, after killing the ship's real captain, assumes his identity, with the intention of Killing the group one-by-one. He is a Stand User, wielding the unique aquatic-based Dark Blue Moon.

is a Stand wielded by Enrico Pucci, featured in Stone Ocean. The Stand is the final metamorphosis in a chain following Whitesnake and C-MOON, one of the very last elements of the plan referenced in DIO's Diary. It was considered by DIO to be the ultimate Stand and the key to achieving "heaven".

The Mine Resistant Ambush Protected (MRAP) vehicle is a light vehicle (not classified as an armored fighting vehicle) with added protection against improvised explosive devices, and the infantry ambushes that may follow. The hull of an MRAP is specifically designed to deflect explosions from buried munitions, riding higher above ground and featuring a sloped undercarriage rather than a traditional flat bottom. Several vehicles used by the United States carry the MRAP designation. They're increasingly phasing out the HMMWVs in US-frontline-service. Among them is the Cougar, an American infantry mobility vehicle. The Cougar H Variant has four wheels.

is a minor antagonist and Stand user featured in Steel Ball Run. He is President Funny Valentine's personal bodyguard. When Lucy Steel and Hot Pants infiltrate the President's residence in Chicago, he ends up battling the pair in order to protect his employer. Mike O. is a Stand User, creating deadly metal balloons through his Tubular Bells.

The Budogaoka High School Spirit is an unnamed primary character featured in the first episode of the Diamond is Unbreakable Drama CD Collection. She was a piano player who attended Budogaoka High School before her eventual suicide. As a ghost, she now haunts the school at night.

is a tertiary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run. Stroheim is a German competitor in the Steel Ball Run race. Armed with a gun concealed in his cybernetic right hand, he attacks Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli during the 2nd Stage.

A Muzzle Brake is a weapon attachment designed to redirect the weapon's propellant gases horizontally with the effect of lowering the muzzle climb of the weapon. Muzzle Brakes were originally made for artillery and anti-tank guns, and have been adapted for use with various rifles and handguns.

is a tertiary ally featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, and a primary ally in the light novel Lonesome Tim. He is a horse belonging to Mountain Tim, who rides him during his work as a bounty hunter and throughout the Steel Ball Run race.

An unnamed appears as a tertiary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. It is a Rock Organism that disguises as a traditional hair clip from the Chinese and attacks Yasuho Hirose when she is thirteen years old.

is the protagonist of Gorgeous Irene. She is a teenage girl with a pure personality. Despite her innocent nature, she is secretly a skilled assassin nicknamed , with various techniques using makeup. Irene also appears in the spin-off series Cool Shock Old B.T. as a secondary antagonist, specifically in "" and the extra chapter "."
Mobile Resupply is a vehicle specialization introduced with Battlefield Hardline: Robbery for Scout Helicopters. The specialization allows Scout Helicopters to resupply nearby teammates or occupants.

is a tertiary antagonist featured in the light novel El Aleph. She is an orphan who was kidnapped by Fernando Arjón and his men and forced to work after they shot her with the Bow and Arrow, awakening her Stand, Hopscotch.

is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. He is a mysterious teenage high school student who helps a young Josuke Higashikata and his mother Tomoko get to the hospital by pushing their car when it is stuck in a blizzard. Josuke catches a glimpse of the boy and aspires to become a hero like him. He imitates the boy's hairstyle and doesn't forgive anyone who would insult it, as he would feel like they were insulting his hero.

This unnamed Stand possessed by Jonathan Joestar's corpse and used by DIO is featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders. It is a plant-like Stand that bears a resemblance to Joseph's Hermit Purple and shares similar abilities. DIO uses its power to track down the Joestar group throughout their journey.

The Beretta MX4 Storm is a submachine gun chambered in 9x19mm Para, with a barrel length of 12 inches. It is select-fire, with an automatic rate of fire of about 800 rpm. The MX4 can use standard 92FS pistol magazines, or its own 30 round magazine. It has in integrated full-length rail for mounting various attachments. The MX4 appears in two games in the Battlefield series.

is a character featured in the canceled light novel The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp, based on the fourth part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Diamond is Unbreakable. He is a 9-year-old boy who moves to Morioh with his mother on June 1, 2000. He befriends Josuke Higashikata and learns about the mysterious phenomenon happening to his body being a Stand.

is a secondary antagonist featured in Baoh the Visitor. He is a ferocious, artificially evolved mandrill created by Dr. Kasuminome at the Dress Organization. He and his master are tasked with assassinating Ikuro Hashizawa.

is the main antagonist of the special episode "Kyoka Izumi Will Not Be Silenced." She is the younger twin sister of Soshi Saion and the creator of Shumeisha's recent hit manga series Midhope. Initially presented as a mute prodigy, Mika is actually a deceptive individual with an ability to steal people's voices to write her manga's highly acclaimed dialogue.

tank.]] A Mobility Kill (or M-kill) in armored warfare is a vehicle that is immobilized, or the act of immobilizing such a target. Tanks and other armored fighting vehicles can be immobilized by damage to their engines, tracks, or running gear. Because of the mobile nature of modern warfare, such a vehicle is often effectively useless on the battlefield, but it may be repaired and brought back into action quickly.

The , also called the or the , is the main antagonist of the short story "Yuyanagidai", part of the Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan: Short Story Collection. He is the ghost of an old man who died alone long ago. Revived by the prayers of Yuyanagidai's elders, he exists only to silence anyone who causes a disturbance in the neighborhood.

, also known as the , is the main antagonist of Lonesome Tim, a light novel based on Steel Ball Run. A notorious and highly dangerous outlaw, he is responsible for robbing seven banks and murdering over twenty people before fleeing, as well as massacring the Sand Readers tribe. Reed is also a Stand user, whose Sea of Heart Break allows him to control the priority of actions between him and his target.

is a tertiary antagonist featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He is an incarnation of the original Secco, living in the 37th universe. Secco Rottario wields the Stand Evil Dead and is a member of Passione who invades Morioh and attacks random civilians.

Mare's Leg is a general name referring to a lever-action rifle (commonly a Winchester Model 1892) that has been given a shortened barrel and a sawed off stock so it can be used similarly to a pistol. They are a small enough size to fit into a large leg holster, and can be chambered for .44-40 or .38-40 Winchester, as well as .44 and .357 Magnum rounds. A weapon specifically called the "Mare's Leg" appeared in the TV show Wanted: Dead or Alive. A cut down, tactical Marlin 1894 rifle chambered for .44 Magnum appears in Battlefield 4 as the "Mare's Leg". It is customized with a tri-rail, top scout rail, Ghost Ring Sights, and an enlarged lever loop.

is the main antagonist of the one-shot At a Confessional, the 16th episode of the Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan series, as well as a primary antagonist in the At a Confessional live-action film. He is only named in the film. An impoverished man turned vengeful spirit, he holds a grudge against the man who wronged him after unintentionally causing his death.

are the main antagonists of Deadman's Questions. They are entities that exist to purge ghosts from the world to negate overpopulation in a role similar to nature's . Kira encountered a nest of them within the ghost of a soldier's mansion.
is the Stand of Usagi Alohaoe, featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands. It enables Usagi to summon up any object someone else requests.
Mobile Armory refers to three similar vehicle specializations featured in Battlefield Hardline.

is the main antagonist of the short story "The Five-Bedroom House With...", part of the Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan: Short Story Collection. Claimed to be a yokai by Rohan Kishibe, it is a creature of light that invades homes as part of a ritual for those who call upon it.

is the Stand of Paco Laburantes, featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands. The Hustle grants Paco a supernaturally fine control over his musculature, enabling him to contract his muscles in innovative ways.

is the main antagonist of The Book ~jojo's bizarre adventure 4th another day~, a light novel based on Diamond is Unbreakable. He is a student residing in Morioh who finds himself entangled in a murder incident, prompting him to hunt for Josuke Higashikata and his friends after their investigation leads to him as a major suspect. Takuma is also a Stand user wielding The Book, which allows him to utilize his photographic memory and cause his opponents to relive his memories when they touch the Stand's pages.

An Elephant Gun is a large caliber firearm intended for hunting, as the name implies, big game like elephants or rhinoceroses. Early elephant guns were large bore black powder guns that fired solid lead balls, but modern elephant guns fire high caliber cartridges like the .700 Nitro Express or .600 Overkill rounds. Generally, these rifles are either single-shot, double barrel, or bolt-action guns, with the intent being that the round would have enough stopping power to kill charging game with only a few shots. A triple-barreled Merkel Drilling elephant gun firing .700 Nitro Express is featured in Battlefield Hardline as the Mammoth Gun.

, born , is a primary antagonist featured in The Book: 4th Another Day, a light novel based on Diamond is Unbreakable. He is usually referred to by his original surname, Ogami. He is a corrupt architect who attempts to murder his girlfriend Akari Hirai to cover up his embezzlement. He is a Stand user who unknowingly uses his ability, Memory of Jet, to forcibly isolate Akari from the world, trapping her between two buildings for months while preventing passersby from being able to perceive her. Teruhiko is also the father of Takuma Hasumi and Chiho Futaba.

is the main antagonist of Rohan au Louvre. It is a painting created by the Japanese artist Nizaemon Yamamura around the 17th century. It depicts a portrait of the late Nizaemon's wife, Nanase Kishibe, made entirely out of the blackest and purest ink in the world, taken from the pigment of an ancient tree's trunk. The pigment that Nizaemon extracted from the 2000-year-old tree came from a substance drawn from insects living in the very core of the trunk. These infinitely black creatures, resembling spiders, were hidden in the darkness since the dawn of time and are now bound to the painting. Thus, the painting is actually "alive", attacking whoever approaches it in response to Nizaemon's hatred.

is the main antagonist of the short story "Original Author Rohan Kishibe", part of the Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan: Short Story Collection. He is an assistant director with dreams of being a professional actor. After suffering mistreatment and humiliation throughout the production of The Gentleman of the Foreign Residences TV drama adaptation, Yumeo eventually snaps and manifests a mental incarnation of the character Orobog, using the character's power over water to take revenge on the cast and crew.

The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mondrag%C3%B3n_rifle Mondragón Modelo 1908] is a Mexican semi-automatic rifle introduced in 1908, designed by Mexican officer Manuel Mondragón. Manufactured by SIG of Switzerland, the weapon was the first semi-automatic rifle adopted by any army, having been issued to Mexican Army units in 1911. The Imperial German army also bought and used the Mondragón rifle. In the service of the latter, the Germans found reliability to be a concern in the muddy terrain encountered by the Infantry, and so it was instead issued to the Flying Corps, where it was used by air crews until sufficient numbers of machine guns equipped with synchronization gear was available.

The Masked Men are a pair of characters in Katana Zero, named Comedy and Tragedy. They are a pair of beings with seemingly supernatural abilities, often appearing in Zero's Chronos hallucinations.

The was a light machine gun designed in and first issued in 1902, making it the world's first light machine gun produced in significant quantity. First adopted by the the weapon would be later sold in 12 calibers to 34 different countries, including France, Germany, Italy and the Russian Empire. Although expensive to produce, it was recognized for its reliability, and as such remains in the service of a few armies to this day.

Azumaya is the second fighter who Kenichi Shirahama fights in the underground battle arena. He goes by the nickname "Drummer Azumaya" and is known to to crush his opponents with a pair of small wooden swords. Kenichi defeats him by using his shortest strong combo.
Yinlin attacks her opponent with a series of powerful kicks. This is one of the secret techniques of Bagua.

The Maxim machine gun was the world's first recoil-operated machine gun, invented in 1883. Most of the belt-fed heavy machine guns of World War I were derived from the Maxim, such as the British Vickers, the German MG 08 and the Russian Maxim M1910 as seen in the picture.

is a YOMI member, the disciple of Mikumo Kushinada and a first-year student at Koryo's High School who is a Japanese child prodigy that practices Kushinada style jujutsu.
Enshin Chou was the disciple of Jisei Ro and a temporary holder of the Moon Emblem for Yomi. His alias is Pure Dragon.

Modified Armored Train is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1, introduced in the Battlefield 1: In the Name of the Tsar expansion. It is unlocked upon obtaining ten kills with the Modified Armored Train. However, it is also possible to use only the standard Armored Train, and will be unlocked together with the Codex Entry The Armored Train.

Dairen Ou is one of the three thugs who attempts to fight Kenichi Shirahama after the latter's first battle with Boris Ivanov. He is a practioner of Hakkakuken and wears a skin-tight black shirt with lighter-colored outlines. Along with Jun Sanada and Tadamoto Kashima, Dairen desires to test his skills against Kenichi and easily blocks his normal attacks. However, he is just as easily defeated by Kenichi's Mubyoshi.

better known as "Takeda the Puncher", "Takeda the Fist" or "Takeda the Striker", is one of the captains of the Shinpaku Alliance and currently a third year student at Kōryō High School who was formerly part of Ragnarök's Technique Trio, along with Kōzō Ukita and Taichi Koga.

Jonathan is a seagull owned by Apachai Hopachai. Apachai's abillity to communicate with animals allows him to understand what Jonathan is saying. It is Jonathan who locates Haruo Niijima on the beaches of Japan after the latter is shipped out by the fourth and fifth fists of Ragnarok: Loki and Siegfried.

The was a - submachine gun that produced between 1929 and 1940. Originally conceived at the German plant, the S1-100 was produced in Switzerland and Austria under the Steyr-Solothurn outlet. It was adopted by the as the MP 34 in 1934, and was sold to various other countries such as , , China, and Japan, in a variety of different calibers. The S1-100 was expensive to produce, but was noted for its exceptional quality. It came into limited use by the during World War II, and was designated the MP34(ö) in German service. Hibiki Yūki (結城 ひびき Yūki Hibiki), not to be confused with Hibiki Kugenin who is better known as Siegfried who was the fifth fist of Ragnarök, is the flail-wielding member of the Valkyries under Kaname Kugatachi better known as Freya the third fist of Ragnarok and the only one thus far to have a known name.

Moritz's Magnetic Hurler is a sniper rifle featured in Battlefield Heroes. Available for the Commando kit of the National Army it was introduced in the Scientists bundle on February 14, 2012. Its counterpart is Albert's Accelerator for the Royal Army and is statistically and functionally identical.

The Yokosuka MXY-7 Ohka was a rocket-powered suicide aircraft used by the Japanese towards the end of World War II.

The Loki Shadows are subordenates of Loki. They are underlings who are all disguised as him (except one that is obviously much fatter than the real one) that have used them to distract and confuse opponents. While not as strong as Loki himself, they are much stronger than Loki's normal followers and are at the very least, strong enough to pretend to be him. Loki uses them as decoys to trick his enemies out into the open and as an ambush team. All of them use double-ended stun batons to attack their opponents. Meat Man is a wrestling disciple of Diego Carlo. whom like all wrestlers possess a strong body, however he proclaims sadly if resolutely to have no talent.

The Sd.Kfz. 138 Ausf. M Panzerjäger 38(t), more commonly known as the Marder III (German; Marten) was a tank destroyer used by the Wehrmacht during World War II. The vehicle was a modification of the Panzer 38(t) light tank, and was equipped with a 7.5cm Pak 40 anti-tank gun within an open-top superstructure. It entered service in 1942.
A is a powerful martial artist that is far more powerful than a regular person, Disciple and Expert.
The Assassin is a high-ranking Nobody controlled by Axel that is found in Kingdom Hearts II.

The Anti Black Coat is a Nightmare that emerged from the darkness surrounding Sora when he was plunged into sleep. He can be found in The World That Never Was in Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance and its remaster Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD.

The is a multi-caliber anti-materiel rifle produced in South Africa since the 1990s. It can be chambered for cartridges ranging from to , feeding from a magazine mounted on the weapon's left side. The 65-pound weapon is fielded by a crew of two, one carrying the receiver, and the other the barrel and ammunition. To aid in carrying, a large rounded carrying handle is often affixed to the weapon. A future variant of the weapon dubbed the NTW-50 appears in .
The Bruiser is an Unversed that is found in Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep and Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix.

The Dark Figure, also referred to as Xehanort's Guardian, was an entity formed after Master Xehanort forced his heart into the body of Terra. The being is summoned by Ansem, Seeker of Darkness throughout the Kingdom Hearts series. It is first created by Terra-Xehanort, Ansem's original persona, before his final battle with Aqua in Radiant Garden during Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep. The Guardian is also used by Riku when he takes on the form of "Ansem" during his battle with Roxas towards the conclusion of Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days. The Guardian serves not only to protect its host from attacks, but also to fight for him when needed. The Heartless acts as a container for Terra's heart, though during his time as Terra-Xehanort, his heart would travel back and forth between Terra-Xehanort's body and the Dark Figure.

Fake Vivi is a combatant in the Simulated Twilight Town's Struggle tournament, although he turns out to be a Dusk disguised as Vivi. You must combat Fake Vivi once more as Roxas while searching for the truth behind the Seven Wonders of Twilight Town.
Missile Countermeasures such as infrared flares and electronic jamming protect an air vehicle against incoming missile threats.
Elrena was a Keyblade wielder who appears in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. She was a member of the Dandelions and a frequent teammate of Strelitzia.
The Invisible is a Pureblood Heartless that is found throughout the Kingdom Hearts series.
The Assault Dragon is an Emblem Heartless that was introduced in Kingdom Hearts Union χ during the Cat Day event in 2017.
Machine Gun Shreddy is a Player Card featured in Battlefield 2042. It is unlocked by obtaining 3 kills each with the LCMG and PKP-BP.

Bear Claw is a technique that appears in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. It allows the user to leap into the air before landing with a powerful crash, kicking up rocks in their wake. It is a signature ability of Aced.

CLU is an antagonist from The Grid who appeared in Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance. He was a program originally created by Kevin Flynn to help oversee The Grid, but having been programmed to create the "perfect system", he betrayed him and took The Grid under his control, while also issuing the complete annihilation of the ISOs. He originated from the Disney film, .
The Flutterings is a Pureblood Heartless that was introduced in Kingdom Hearts Union χ as a boss in Enchanted Dominion.

The Crye Precision SIX12 is a compact bullpup gas-seal double-action revolving shotgun developed by Crye Precision USA. The SIX12 is a modular weapon with interchangeable barrels for various applications, and can be configured as a full-length standalone weapon with a stock and handguard, fitted with a short barrel and rear pistol grip for use as a compact breaching weapon, or mounted to a rifle as a Masterkey-style accessory shotgun.
The Frost Penguin is a Gummi Emblem Heartless that appears in Kingdom Hearts III.
The Huge Snowman is an Emblem Heartless that appears in Kingdom Hearts Union χ as a boss in Beast's Castle.
Last Charge, also called Last Word, is a technique introduced in Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep. It allows the user to charge into an enemy.

Mrs. Incredible is a character in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. She is a superhero who possesses superhuman elasticity.

The Master of Masters, also known simply as the Master, is a Keyblade Master who appears in Kingdom Hearts χ. Gifted with the power of foresight, he writes the Book of Prophecies and trains six apprentices: Ira, Aced, Invi, Gula, Ava, and Luxu.
Acrobat Alien, as his name suggest, is an acrobatic Kaiju from another planet.

The [https://www.imfdb.org/wiki/Q_The_Fix Q The Fix] is an American bolt-action rifle produced by [https://liveqordie.com/firearms/ Q, LLC], chambered in various cartridges. It was developed in 2018, using or SR-25 magazines to feed, and often fitted with a bespoke suppressor - also developed by Q. The Q The Fix is chambered in , or . A scaled down version known as the Q Mini Fix is available in , or .

Petey Piranha is a character from the Mario franchise and one of Mario's foes. He is a giant, mutated Piranha Plant. Though he has not appeared in The Legend of Zelda series or its spinoffs, Petey Piranha does appear in a few games of the Super Smash Bros. series, notably being the initial kidnapper of Princess Zelda in Adventure Mode: The Subspace Emissary of Super Smash Bros. Brawl.

Tingles are beings of all sorts that has turned into slaves. He lures them to his pool and gives them a lust for Rupees, along with a green suit to match. He promises them that if they collect enough Rupees for him, they will be able to enter Rupeeland. After they obtain a high enough amount of Rupees, they do indeed go to Rupeeland. When they reach Rupeeland, they find out that it is a desolate, evil place, and that they will have to serve Uncle Rupee for all eternity. Tingles can survive things that would kill non-Tingles. However, when they do, they lose Rupees. Rupees are a Tingle's lifeforce. If a Tingle runs out of Rupees, they'll revert to normal and die. Tingle was a Tingle until he found out the truth about Uncle Rupee from the Grand Fairy, and defeated the Rupee Master once and for all. It is unknown as to why he kept the name "Tingle" along with his green outfit.

, a general-purpose machine gun.]] A (commonly abbreviated MG) is a fully automatic firearm, usually designed to fire rounds in quick succession from an ammunition belt or magazine, typically at a rate of several hundred rounds per minute. Machine guns are generally categorized as "light", "medium", or "heavy", and have been featured in every game in the Battlefield series to date. Mounted light and heavy machine guns are attached to pedestals at fixed firing positions, pintles on vehicles that may expose the user, or remote weapon systems that allow the user to remain inside armor. In this sense, light vehicle armor (such as on scout cars or aircraft) is capable of defending against an LMG, while it is defeated by an HMG. Coaxial mounted weapons are aimed by use of the main gun control, providing a secondary weapon using the same sighting system.

Agrus Kos was an officer of the League of Wojek in the Boros Legion. From a young age, Kos believed in upholding the law. As an orphan, his only dream was to join the Boros and protect the citizenry of Ravnica. Kos epitomized the tough "street cop" archetype, complete with a drinking problem and a distaste for rookies. After his death, he became a spirit.
Alhammarret was a sphinx mind mage from Vryn, who tutored and was later killed by Jace Beleren.
Lady Ana was a minor noble, and a member of the Forward Order in the Caligo Forest on Dominaria. She was the mentor of Liliana Vess, widely renowned for her healing abilities.

A Motorcycle (also called a motorbike, bike, moto or cycle) is a two or three wheeled motor vehicle. Motorcycles vary considerably depending on the task they are designed for, such as long distance travel, navigating congested urban traffic, cruising, sport and racing, or off-road conditions. Arjun, called The Shifting Flame, is a sphinx who resides in an obscure corner of the Multiverse. His mind, like that of the other sphinxes, is a living puzzle, a shifting maze of enigma and paradox, which has roots in the wisdom of the ages. Arjun shares this wisdom with a school of philosophers, who revere him as a divine being.

Marshal Barktooth Warbeard was an old soldier from the kentsu. He lead the occupation force on Kusho, but was killed and replaced by the shapeshifter Halfdane, who had been ordered by his master Ramses Overdark to infiltrate the kentsu. According to legend, Barktooth fought a hydra.

Ben-Ben (BEHN-behn; ) was a foul-smelling outcast akki hermit on Kamigawa. An eccentric goblin, he was smarter than the average akki and known to wear an octopus on his head and carry lotus flowers. He possessed the ability to manipulate stones with his mind through a ritual he performed by wheezing and coughing.

The (IWI) , or Micro Tavor, is a standalone military weapon used for close quarters combat. It is designated to use the cartridge and the Indian cartridge. It is also compatible with the German cartridge. The weapon is renowned around the world for its efficiency in close quarters combat and its ability to use a variety of munitions. It is currently operated as the Micro-Tavor in the and the Zittara in the Indian Military. An updated variant with a larger trigger guard is designated as the X95. The MTAR-21 appears in Battlefield Play4Free, Battlefield 3 and Battlefield 2042, while an X95 appears in Battlefield 4.

Ashling was a female flamekin on a pilgrimage through Lorwyn, serving occasionally as a messenger for various races. She was searching for a greater elemental, a mythical embodiment of higher nature principles, whose call she subconsciously followed, though she did not know where it may lead.
Bartek is a young, tall and strong crate loader on Ravnica who fell into a setup by the Bane Alley broker Andra.

Boris Devilboon, later known as Dead Boris, was a wizard and a minion of the imperial assassin Ramses Overdark. In life, Boris was a sickly-looking man with a tiny mustache. He followed Ramses loyally, even though the assassin treated him poorly. Boris could create tiny creatures made of flames which he called his "little friends," and could predict the future via the medium of vague rhyming verses. Overdark was annoyed by the inaccuracy of these predictions and killed Boris. He then resurrected him, which vastly improved the mage's abilities. It didn't matter much, however, as Tetsuo Umezawa wanted vengeance from Overdark and killed all the assassin's minions that stood in his way. Devilboon summoned an entire army of "little friends" that were made of rotting flesh, tar, and offal instead of hot lava. Tetsuo destroyed his undead form, dispelling his summonings as well.

A Mobile Anti-Air (MAA) vehicle (aka Anti-Air Artillery, Triple A, Air Defense) is a self-propelled artillery piece that is used to repel or defeat enemy aircraft using cannons or guided missiles. Although land-locked and much less mobile than aircraft, it can make use of nearby terrain to supplement its armor and specialized weapons. Though not designed for use against ground armor or infantry, MAA vehicles can defend themselves against infantry or supplement a ground attack. Certain vehicles can also damage ground armor. *:Category:Anti Aircraft Vehicles

Biracazir was the wolf mount of the ledev wolfrider Fonn Zunich on Ravnica. He was sired by Voja. Biracazir was present during the Decamillennial convocation at Vitu-Ghazi and was a first-hand witness of Szadek's return. Biracazir attacked the ancient vampire, but was seriously wounded. When Szadek attempted to drain Mat'Selesnya's life energy, bringing the Selesnyan parun at the brink of death, Fonn used the green gem from Saint Bayul, that connected an individual's mind to the mind of the Conclave. Biracazir's lifeforce helped to recreate Mat'Selesnya's strength. After the new dryad conclave was spawned by the parun to replace the group killed by Szadek, Biracazir remained at Vitu-Ghazi as its protector and overseer.

Brand was a planeswalker. Knowing his Outer Ring was threatened, Brand became desperate for a way to keep from losing it to another wizard. He sought support from his friend Mindrel and told her he planned to learn dark magic. Mindrel tried to talk him out of it by explaining the dangers. However, Brand did not heed her warning. Brand returned home where he met his challenger. He used dark magic that destroyed both him and his plane, and his familiar died curled up by the fireplace. It is unlikely that Brand's opponent was defeated.
Brallin is a Human Shaman from Ikoria. He is bonded with the monstrous Shark Bird Shabraz.

A Machete is a large cutting tool. It is generally used to cut through dense foliage or other environments. As it is a bladed weapon, it can be used as a Combat Knife, or as a makeshift surgical implement for amputation of limbs.
Bristly Bill is a cactusfolk druid from Thunder Junction. He uses his skills in magic to tend to the cacti and natural flora of the frontier plane.

Chainer was a Dominarian pit-fighter and a dementia caster for the Cabal. As a cabalist, the name "Chainer" was a nickname, while his real (secret) name was Mazeura. Chainer was the first person known to have found the Mirari on Dominaria. Initially, he was able to resist its lure, but ultimately he became obsessed with it and was consumed by its power.

Chaney was an archdruid during Modern Times on Aerona on Dominaria. By her own accord she was able to planeswalk but hadn't done so in many years. She healed Greensleeves' broken ankle and Gull's knee. Chaney taught Greensleeves how to harness mana and planeswalking. During her training, Greensleeves found out that time in Chaney's house flew differently and what seems to be mere days, were indeed years. When Gull and the rest of the army finally found her, Greensleeves had grown up and become a much more skilled wizard. Chaney suffered a severe stroke, with half her body limp. In her dying moment, her life force was absorbed by Greensleeves. Three years later, Chaney returned as a shade, urging Greensleeves to make the "final sacrifice". After Greensleeves dons the Stone Brain and finds out that its ultimate secret is buried somewhere in the ruins of the College of Lat-Nam, Chaney's shade passes in the afterlife.
A Melee Weapon is a weapon designed for hand-to-hand combat. Various melee weapons appear in the Battlefield series:

The Coiled One is a powerful, mysterious, and ancient snake god "of venom and vengeance" from Innistrad associated with dark magic. It appears to embody darkness and chaos, capable of exerting control and influence through serpentine symbols and artifacts, such as the mask Sinnia found. The Coiled One's presence is oppressive and tangible, affecting the environment and those around it.

Cecilee was a blonde elven druid who tried to make a Selesnyan enclave in the Rubblebelt of Ravnica. She had a connection with the Worldsoul of Ravnica, and followed its voice through her work, but during an attack by Rakdos cultists, Cecilee was killed by Massacre Girl.
Cyril Rav was a necro-alchemist from Innistrad whose use of a geist-bomb turned him into a geist that could possess people's bodies.

Mark V may refer to: *Mark V Patrol Boat - A boat featured in Battlefield: Bad Company and Battlefield: Bad Company 2 *Mark V Landship - A tank featured in Battlefield 1 **The Mark V Tank (Codex Entry) - A Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1.
Dennick Betzold was a human soldier, and a son of bishop Worrin Betzold. After his death he became a spirit soldier. He was a native of Gavony, Innistrad.
Dokai (DOH-keye), Weaver of Life, is a human monk of Kamigawa from the time of the Kami War.
Damir, called the Voidwielder, is a guildless wizard on Ravnica. At one point he was on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals, as a renegade mage with a vendetta against humanity.

The PT-76 is a Soviet amphibious light tank designed between 1949 and 1951 and produced from 1953 to 1969. It was the standard Soviet reconnaissance tank until the fall of the Soviet Union, being replaced by BMP-3s and BMD-3s in the Russian Ground Forces. It was widely exported to friendly countries like India, North Korea, Iraq and North Vietnam.
El-Hajjâj (EL ha-JAJ) was a powerful wizard from Rabiah, and possibly one of the few people not copied in the Thousand-fold Refraction.
Edgar Markov is the founder of the Markov bloodline, and the first vampire of Innistrad.
Eleni is an elf from Naya, who became a berserker in Jund after the Conflux.

The Panzer IV is a German medium tank used in World War II. The Panzer IV was the only German tank to see combat over the whole of World War II, from Norway to Poland to the Battle of the Bulge and the Fall of Berlin. During the later stages of the war, it was supplemented by the Panther tank, which was to replace it. Regardless, the venerable Panzer IV remained in service to the end of the war with Germany, and beyond in other countries. __TOC__

Eusomoné was a minotaur of Hurloon on Dominaria. He was also called "Sings Two Ways," and once befriended Adam Carthalion. Eusomoné was later summoned by Jared Carthalion to fight off one of Ravidel's giant spiders in Arathoxia; he gave Jared the Foecleaver, and returned home to be healed of the spider's poison he was afflicted with from the battle.
Estrid is a planeswalker introduced in Commander 2018. Estrid wears many faces, only occasionally wearing her own. She is an enchantress, able to hide herself and others behind a mask.
Esior is a Bird from an unknown plane, and a Mage's familiar.

The PPSh (Russian: Pistolet-Pulemyot Shpagina; English: Shpagin machine pistol), more specifically the PPSh-41, is a Soviet submachine gun designed by Georgi Shpagin in 1941. The PPSh was designed to be a cheap and effective replacement for the PPD-40. It was mass-produced with 6 million units produced by the end of World War II. It proved to have unmatched close range firepower with its 900 rounds per minute rate of fire and 7.62x25mm cartridges typically placed in a 71-round drum magazine. After the war, it became obsolete in Soviet Russia and was sold to other Soviet allies such as the People's Republic of China, North Korea and North Vietnam.
Eruth of Lambholt is a young woman from Innistrad who gained notoriety for her clairvoyant dreams. She is now a gibbering lunatic living in the Natternols.
Ertai was a talented, arrogant young wizard from Tolaria who signed on to be the Skyship Weatherlights mage. He was resurrected during the second Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria.
Garruk (pronounced GAIR-ruck), called the Wildspeaker, is a planeswalker with warrior-druid abilities and a special affinity with animals and beasts.

The Type 95 SPAAA (PLA military designation: PGZ-95) is a Chinese self-propelled anti-aircraft vehicle. It is armed with four 25 millimeter cannons and optionally four fire-and-forget QW-2 infra-red homing missiles. It was first displayed publicly at the Beijing Military Parade in 1999. The Type 95 SPAAA appears in Battlefield 2 and Battlefield 4. __TOC__

Galo Aher was a Knight of Bant and a member of the Order of the White Orchid. He was considered a paragon of honor but was killed by a blast of fire while battling invaders from the shard of Jund. A sigil was created in his image which protected the bearer from pyromancy and similar forms of hostile magic.

Gavi is a human shaman on the plane of Ikoria. Instead of living in one of the sanctuaries, Gavi lived in the monster-infested wilds of Raugrin. There, she was adopted as a surrogated mother by a litter of baby cat dinosaurs, displaying a connection to the creatures of Ikoria that even bonders envy: she demands the respect-and often fierce devotion of even the most ferocious dinosaurs that roam Raugrin’s crags. The mother cat dino had been killed by a hunter, and the eggs had just hatched when Gavi happened upon the nest. Consequently, the brood imprinted upon her and followed her around everywhere she went. Gavi protects them from any threat or monster happening to find them. Now, Gavi spends her days in the wilds, passing on her knowledge to her adopted brood of monsters. Those who mistake her calm demeanor for weakness tend to realize their error as they are devoured by cat dinosaurs. She is one of the few humans that had earned the respect of the planeswalker Vivien Reid.
Gadrak, the Crown-Scourge, is a dragon from an unknown plane.

Night Vision Goggles, also called NVGs or NODs (Night Optical/Observation Devices), are special helmet mounted binoculars used by military forces to allow soldiers to see in low light conditions. The goggles perform this by using an image intensifier, a vacuum-tube device that converts invisible light into visible light to produce a dimly lit image. The AN/PVS series is the one of the more commonly used NVGs by the United States military, along with the more recently developed GPNVP goggles.

Greel was a strange humanoid horror controlled by the Keldons during the Keldon Invasion of Jamuraa on Dominaria. Greel fed off the life force of others, which then caused him to rapidly grow, changing from a young boy to an adult in a matter of weeks. He served as a familiar for Erissa and Latulla to aid in their spellcasting. His origins are unknown. Greel is mainly noteworthy for killing Rayne. He was killed by Barrin, husband of Rayne, soon after.
Golden-Tail () was a taciturn kitsune kensei (master swordsman) from Kamigawa.

Gleemax is the name for the mythical giant alien brain in a jar that secretly runs Magic: The Gathering R&D. He is said to occupy “The Forbidden Room” in an underground lair below the corporate offices. It is an in-joke among the staff of Wizards of the Coast.

An Orbital Strike is the act of attacking targets on a planet or moon by the shooting unit in orbit around the object, rather than from an aircraft, or land-based artillery. Orbital Strikes are used in Battlefield 2142.
Gisa Cecani (Gee-sah Seh-sahn-nee) is a black-aligned necromancer from Innistrad. She has a rivalry with her twin brother Geralf Cecani.
Ghave (/ɡeɪv/ gayv), Guru of Spores, is the mycoid heroic shaman of the fungus and saproling in the war against the humans of Drakkus.
King Glarb, also referred to as His Moistness, is a frogfolk from Bloomburrow. He is king of the frogfolk and a powerful wizard.

The NetBat Helmet (Network Battlefield System) is an advanced piece of equipment used by soldiers in the 22nd Century by both the European Union and the Pan-Asian Coalition. It is featured in Battlefield 2142 as a justification for 3D Spotting, the extra layers of intel provided by class-specific upgrades and gadgets, and HUD elements as would be visible to the player character. The equipment is standard for all kits and worn at all times.

Gorev Hadszak is a retired Wojek on the plane of Ravnica. Grizzled in every sense of the word—his face, and of unknown age, but despite his gray hair and weathered features, he still looks like he could wrestle a drunken ogre out of a bar or knock out a Rakdos spiker. His wrists were as thick as most men's calves and his arms were covered in scars.

Hayokai was one of the kittens of the Nekoru Wasitora on Dominaria. His name means Swiftly Striking, from which Kolo Meha derived his nickname, "Swifty". He was midnight black, and the brute of the five kittens.

Gwendolyn Carthalion (née Gwendolyn Mor) was a blue mage, the daughter of Grenfell Mor, and the wife of Adam Carthalion, as well as Jared Carthalion’s mother. Adam sacrificed her to the “god” Ravidel in his quest to become a planeswalker.
The North American Aviation P-51 Mustang was an American long-range single-seat World War II fighter aircraft conceived, designed and built by North American Aviation (NAA).

Hythonia is a gorgon who resides on the plane of Theros and has a deep connection to the serpentine god Pharika. She is known by others as "Hythonia the Cruel", as she delights in transforming living creatures to stone and adding them to her throne.

Haaach is a criminal goblin berserker from Alara who became wanted on Naya. He has been known as Haaach of the Bloodhall, The Hackblade, What the Hell Was That?, and The Piranha of Valeron. He has been wanted for twelve infractions of Bant war laws - including three aggravated prayer violations and five instances of dishonorable initiation of force outside the lawful hours of wartime, possession of a stolen weapon, assault with a jagged golden sword, and speeding.
Homura (HOH-moo-rah), Human Ascendant, was a human monk of Kamigawa from the time of the Kami War.

The PDR (Personal Defense Rifle) is a compact, bullpup-style 5.56x45mm carbine developed by Magpul Industries. Although the project was abandoned, it has garnered some attention, largely due to its "futuristic" appearance. The system consists of a gas-operated bullpup that was intended to replace some submachine guns, M9 pistols and M4 Carbines in an ultra-compact firearm. It is known in the Battlefield series as the Personal Defense Weapon-Rifle (PDW-R) and appears as the PDR-C variant.

Jason Carthalion, of the renowned Carthalion lineage, was a mighty hero from the Ice Age of Dominaria. He was a ward to Oriel Kjeldos, the champion of Clan Emerald of Storgard and a user of green mana.
Jenrik was a mysterious astronomancer living in a tall tower on the Silver Beach of Innistrad's province of Nephalia.

Illuna, the Wish-Giver is the apex monster of the Ketria triome on Ikoria. Illuna is an ethereal being with the power to weave dreams and grant wishes, who floats through Ketria from crystal to crystal. Little is known for certain about Illuna, and what is known seems to defy the logic of the waking world. Illuna is said to quite literally make dreams come true, though it seems to bestow its gifts entirely at its own whim. The planeswalker Vivien Reid is one of the few who have heard Illuna's voice. She spotted Illuna floating through Ketria, murmuring softly. Although she thought her vantage point was obscured, Illuna stared at her, as if it were assessing her very soul. Illuna's cry is an unforgettably beautiful chord that seems to harmonize with the world itself. There is an ancient tale of Illuna conjuring a creature from dreams, but the creature is different with every recounting.
The PKS-07 is a 7x magnification Russian scope. The scope features chevron distance markers as opposed to the crosshairs and mil-dots of the rifle scope.
Jacob Hauken is a human detective from Nephalia, Innistrad. He is a geist-talker, and investigator of geist-related incidents.
Indris is a legendary otterfolk incarnation from Bloomburrow.

Kaervek (KAIR-vehk) the Merciless is a black-aligned human warlock from Dominaria. He was the main antagonist of the Mirage block storyline. Kaervek's lifetime is longer than a normal human's, likely due to his magic, and he was already centuries old by the time the Mirage War started.

The 7.5 cm PaK 40 (7.5 cm Panzerabwehrkanone 40) was a Nazi Germany 7.5 cm anti-tank gun developed in 1939–1941 by [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rheinmetall Rheinmetall] and used during the Second World War. The PaK 40 formed the backbone of German anti-tank guns for the latter part of World War II. It is featured in The Road To Rome and Secret Weapons of WWII expansions of Battlefield 1942 and Battlefield V.

Kei Takahashi was a Dominarian healer-in-training with the natural magical ability to sense danger and to prevent damage. He was the student of Ayesha Tanaka and the healer of Tetsuo Umezawa's entourage.
Karrthus, called the "Tyrant of Jund", is a dragon Ajani Goldmane encountered on his first planeswalk.
Kalitas was the bloodchief of the Ghet, the poorest and least powerful of the vampire families of Malakir on Zendikar.

The Pantsir-S1 (Russian: Панцирь-С1), NATO reporting name SA-22 Greyhound), is a combined short-to-medium range surface-to-air missile and anti-aircraft artillery weapon system produced by KBP of Tula, Russia mounted either on a tracked or wheeled vehicle or stationary. The system is a further development of SA-19/SA-N-11.

Grandfather Karlov was the greediest of the Orzhov Oligarchs in life. As a ghost he was a member of the Obzedat, the oligarchy that ruled the Orzhov Syndicate on Ravnica. His house sigil was a serpentine ouroboros.

Karshan was a young and powerful black and red planeswalker first mentioned in the Duelist #1. He dueled Anton on at least three occasions. Karshan's haven was in the desolate Ki-Tirn mountain range. At the base of these mountains was the Sharnward Swamp.

Kaheera, the Orphanguard is a legendary cat beast from the plane of Ikoria. When a human hunter slays a monster, they usually leave that monster's offspring to fend for themselves. Kaheera seems driven by instinct to protect any and all young it comes across, and it raises its diverse brood (formed by monsters from every dominant clade of Ikoria) as its own. Kaheera fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
The Nemesis Stock is a weapon attachment featured in Battlefield Play4Free. It provides increased control and precision at the cost of damage.
Jorn is the Skoti god of winter. He is an exceptional tracker who knows the swiftest, safest paths across (and between) every realm.
Kaito is a human cyber Ninja and Planeswalker from Kamigawa. He made his debut in Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty.
Katilda is a strong-willed witch from Innistrad. She is the leader of the Dawnhart Coven.

Kairi is a dragon spirit from Kamigawa. He is the reincarnation of Keiga.
Kharis is a dragon wizard from an unknown plane that was seen through the Eyes of a Beholder.

Kal is an ambitious and inquisitive Gruul shaman and member of the Zhur-Taa clan on Ravnica. In addition to his shamanic magic, he is also trained as a hunter, able to move silently and stalk attentive prey.

Keimon was a vedalken stormcaller from Esper, who discovered first-hand the powerful effects of the Maelstrom.

Kithkin are a quick and agile race of small humanoids, mostly associated with white mana. The first card to bear the creature type was Amrou Kithkin in Legends.

Kobo was a young human apprentice of the ogre shaman Hidetsugu on Kamigawa.

Kiku (KEE-koo; ) was a woman from the Numai swamps on Kamigawa, skilled in both the way of the warrior and in magic. She mastered several weapons, most notably the fuetsu throwing axe and tessen fan. The most deadly, however, are her magic abilities. She used purple camellia blooms that, imbued with her magic, could dig their roots through any living tissue or produce a fragrant smell capable of paralyzing the victim. Kiki-Jiki (kee-kee JEE-kee; ) was an akki of Sokenzan on Kamigawa, who could duplicate creatures with a special brand of illusionism.

Lammasu is a bizarre creature type with the body of a bull, a bird's wings and a human head with horns, based on the Mesopotamian creatures of the same name (and appearance). So far, three lammasu have been printed, all associated with white mana.
Khrad is the Prince of the Telu-Set and a mighty warrior from Muraganda.
Lorthos was a monstrous octopus who lived in the oceans of Zendikar.

The OTs-02 Kiparis (Russian: Кипарис; English: Cypress) is a conventional blow-back operated Russian submachine gun. Originally designed by the TulaCentral Sporting and Hunting Arms Design Bureau (TSKIB SOO) in 1976 for the Soviet Army, the weapon was not adopted until the 1990s when the project was resurrected by the Internal Affairs Ministry. Adopted in 1995, the OTs-02 is issued to the MVD and Russian police, along with a few special operations groups.

Macher is a human cathar on Innistrad. He had doubts about Avacyn's divinity, and his prayer that she be true summoned her to him. But Avacyn had already begun her descent into madness. Instead of comforting Macher, she intimidated him thoroughly, leaving him to scream and cower in her shadow as she flew away. He lay there huddled through the night, cloaked in terrifying certainty about the nature of his god.

Liesa, the Shroud of Dusk, is an archangel from Innistrad. Her entire Flight of Dusk was killed by Avacyn after they sided with a demon lord a millennium ago. Considered apocryphal by the Church of Avacyn, she is not acknowledged with her sisters.

Marhault Elsdragon was the half-elven general of the kentsu during the time of Lady Caleria's uprising against the Empire of Madara on Dominaria. Elsdragon was a powerful warrior and strategist who possessed various kinds of battle magic. He was loyal to Emperor Nicol Bolas in every way, and gladly followed any order that he received from the dragon. Elsdragon was slain by Jorgan Hage under the command of Ramses Overdark, who then assumed control of the kentsu. It was said of Elsdragon that he followed a strict philosophy, never letting emotions cloud his thoughts. And that "No chance observer could imagine the rage in his heart." An obscure text from uncertain provenance says the following about him: A legendary elven warrior whose travels were well-known in ancient times, Elsdragon was changed forever when his ship was burned. Although restrained and civil in normal times, he is a ferocious fighter that embodies chaos in times of war.

A Nail Gun is a type of tool used to drive nails into wood or some other kind of material. It is usually driven by electromagnetism, compressed air, highly flammable gases such as butane or propane, or, for powder-actuated tools, a small explosive charge. The first nail gun used air pressure and was introduced to the market in 1950 to speed the construction of housing floor sheathing and sub-floors. With the original nail gun, the operator used it while standing and could nail 40-60 nails a minute. It had a capacity of 400-600 nails. In the United States alone, thousands of people are injured a year from nail guns. Due to safety concerns, precautions are taken in a similar manner to firearms. As such, nail guns are designed to be used with the muzzle touching the target rather than from a distance. Unless specifically modified, they are not an effective projectile weapon.

Marivel is a panther warrior from Urborg on Dominaria, and the leader of Free Urborg. Marivel lost her parents to the brutality of the Cabal. When she discovered the lost city of Vhelnish, she learned from its ancient knowledge to become one of Urborg's most powerful necromancers and the leader of the Free Urborg resistance. She is currently the ruler of Vhelnish. It is unknown what happened to Marivel after the death of Belzenlok.
Marath, Will of the Wild is a legendary elemental beast from a shaman-ruled plane.
Malcom Lee is a siren and a lifelong member of the Brazen Coalition of pirates on Ixalan.
A Palm Rest is a handle placed close to the trigger that makes holding a rifle easier as it allows the user to let the weapon rest on their forearm instead of having to hold it out.

Molimo is the Maro-Sorcerer for Llanowar, in the Domains of Dominaria. Molimo was already active during the Phyrexian Invasion. Reserved, refined, and reticent, the soul of Llanowar despised strangers as the elves of Llanowar did. He also didn't recognize the authority of Gaea, believing that only Freyalise was the true goddess of nature, even if Multani would point to him that she was but a simple planeswalker. However, he reluctantly helped Multani when he journeyed to Llanowar to find Eladamri and the other refugees, going as far as providing both Multani and Eladamri with the power of the forest. Centuries later, he would be the one to provide Jhoira with a hull seed for the rebuilding of the Skyship Weatherlight.

Mochi, the Smiling Kami of the Crescent Moon, was a powerful yet diminutive kami who attempted to manipulate Toshiro Umezawa, while secretly working with the Soratami to make them the dominant species in the plane Kamigawa.
Mayael is a female shaman and the de facto leader of the Cylian elves from Alara. On Naya, she is also known as the Anima.

The Panzerfaust (English: "Armor Fist" or "Tank Fist") is an inexpensive, single shot, recoilless anti-tank weapon produced by Germany during World War II. It consists of a small, disposable pre-loaded launch tube firing a high-explosive anti-tank grenade, and was intended to be operated by a single soldier. The Panzerfaust's direct ancestor was the similar, smaller-warhead Faustpatrone ordnance device. The Panzerfaust was in use from 1943 until the end of the war. The weapon's concepts played an important part in the development of the later Russian RPG weapon systems such as the RPG-2. Most notably, the RPG-7 added a sustainer rocket motor to the grenade.
The Mimeoplasm is a legendary ooze from Muraganda. It can absorb the power of already dead creatures to advance its form.

Mazena is a charismatic Selesnyan Dryad on the plane of Ravnica, and is one of Trostani's most trusted advisors. She emanates an aura of power and self-assurance. While Ruzi was a member of the guild, Mazena had a strained relationship with him, and she felt he spent too much time training recruits and not enough time promoting the ideals of the Conclave. Ruzi in turn thought of Mazena as particularly conniving, and silently named her Mazena the Manipulative.

Shiko is a spirit dragon native to the plane of Tarkir, affiliated with the Jeskai clan. She embodies the wisdom and discipline of the Jeskai Way while symbolizing the spiritual union between humans and dragons.

The Panzerbüchse 39 (German: Tank Rifle) was a single-shot anti-tank rifle developed in Germany that was first produced in 1939. Developed from the earlier PzB 38, the weapon was the Wehrmacht's standard infantry anti-tank weapon during the early portion of World War II. The weapon used a relatively narrow cartridge, a lengthened version of the standard 7.92mm rifle bullet, that could achieve a velocity high enough to penetrate up to 25mm of armor out to 300m distance. While this was sufficient for disabling light vehicles, the increasing effectiveness of armor on Allied tanks throughout the war rendered the weapon mostly obsolete, leading to its official removal from service in 1944.
Tadeas, Juniper Ascendant, is a legendary human monk from Dominaria.
Tamsyn Sweene was a role taken by a shapeshifter agent of House Dimir, who infiltrated Leighbet's discovery of electrical immunity.
Tahngarth was a proud minotaur warrior from Talruum and the first mate aboard the skyship Weatherlight.

The Rottweil Skeet Olympia 72 (also known as the Model Monreal or the Olympia) is a German-Italian over-under double barreled shotgun. The weapon's design originates from Troisdorf, Germany. It was produced by Italian manufacturer Fratelli Gambaby in 1972 and ceased in the late 1980's. The Olympia 72 is a single-triggered double barrel shotgun with a 14.75 inch length of pull. Like some other shotguns, the Olympia 72 has auto-ejectors; this allows the shells to be ejected automatically when the weapon is "broken" into two, as opposed to most shotguns having only extractors which cause the shells to pop out a little bit when the weapon is "broken" into two. The Olympia 72 appears to have adjustable chokes. The weapon has wooden furniture and has ventilated ribs placed above the barrels. A rubber buttplate is placed at the rear of the stock to absorb some recoil. The Olympia 72 can be separated into two parts; the receiver and the barrel.

Terrent Amese, known as "Durran D'mese" among the Scarwood apes, was a human-shaped being who created the first tribe of Jamuraan tiger warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger. He created them to guard the Dark Heart of the Wood in Scarwood. Deeply religious, these tribes worshiped him, their creator, whom they believed to be a god.
Primus Thriss was a powerful Nantuko druid who became guardian of the Krosan Forest on Dominaria. He convinced Kamahl to abandon his barbarous ways and trained him as a druid.
Trine was a Serra Angel who had been summoned by Archmage Xarl Angel-Keeper.

The Omega Beamer is a light machine gun featured in Battlefield Heroes for the Royal Army. It's counterpart, the Eraser Ray is statistically idential and is available for the National Army. Both weapons were introduced to coincide with the release of Lunar Landing. Unlike other light machine guns, both weapons have the ability to produce a short beam of energy which inflicts a massive amount of damage at short ranges. BFH Laser Miniguns Promo.jpg
Saint Traft was a young priest in the Church of Avacyn on Innistrad. He is now a geist.
Tok-Tok (TOHK-tohk; ) was an old akki shaman on Kamigawa famous for his ability to survive almost anything.
